title: Preallocate scan view wrapper SQL
description: Replace the scan-table view wrapper format! call with an exact-capacity helper.

criteria: Generated wrapper SQL remains SELECT * FROM (<view_sql>) AS _v
Relevant view and join regression tests pass

notes: The helper reserves the fixed prefix, view SQL bytes, and fixed suffix before appending.
The parser receives the same wrapped SQL bytes as the prior format! output.
The change is limited to base table scan view expansion.

commands: rg 'format!\\(\"SELECT \\* FROM \\(\\{\\}\\) AS _v\"|SELECT \\* FROM \\(\\{\\}\\) AS _v' src/execution/scan/mod.rs -n
